payload.credit_html: "Garamaudo bauciensis, a new freshwater mosasaurid (Reptilia, Squamata) from the Santonian (Late Cretaceous) of Provence, southeastern France"
payload.description_html: Geographical location of the Bouc-Bel-Air - Sousquières (BBAS) outcrop in the framework of the Upper Cretaceous continental deposits of the Aix-en-Provence Basin, Provence, southeastern France (after Tortosa et al., 2014). Type locality of the mosasaur Garamaudo bauciensis.
